sources.snippet: TOTORONG/Solon_MOE_p4 architecture at a glance TOTORONG/Solon_MOE_p4 is a model (solon_moe architecture). It uses 48 transformer layers, a hidden size of 3,840, and 16 query heads with 8 key/value heads (grouped-query attention). The feed-forward layers use a mixture-of-experts design with 4 experts.
